meta.title: AI Fraud Detection for a Neo Banking Platform | Panasa
meta.description: Reduced transaction fraud by 62% using real-time AI-based anomaly detection across high-volume payment flows.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: A fast-growing neo banking platform partnered with Panasa to deploy a real-time AI fraud-detection layer across their card and ACH flows, reducing customer-facing fraud without sacrificing transaction success rates.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.body: The combined AI/rules layer now blocks live fraud while protecting the genuine-customer experience that defines the brand.
